sloka: इयम् सराष्ट्रा सजना धन धान्य समाकुला ।मया विसृष्टा वसुधा भरताय प्रदीयताम् ॥२-३४-४१॥
transliteration: iyam sarāṣṭrā sajanā dhana dhānya samākulā ।mayā visṛṣṭā vasudhā bharatāya pradīyatām ॥2-34-41॥

translations.english: The kingdom abdicated by me with all its people, its wealth and foodgrains may be bestowed on Bharata.
